findings.claim: The declared objective is final predicted target affinity as primary, with validity and strain secondary and coordinate control only; the reward view is the endpoint pointcloud with a detached FLOWR endpoint VJP, so coordinate contrasts are not physical interaction energies.

Observed score nodes span the full learning window [0.0,0.5] at 0.01 spacing, and the curve-support audit reports a selected_count of 0 with a 0.0-0.49 support range, so the continuous contrast functions are evaluated on observed-node interpolation only, with no extrapolation permitted.

Landmark soft-mass (landmark_00_soft_mass) shows a whole-window z of 0.639 with 4 sign changes and 1 strong sign conflict, while its first and last rate z-scores are large and opposite in sign; the observed-node linear fit is not polynomial-accepted and has relative node RMSE 0.286, so a constant rule is not supported over a time-conditioned rule for this feature.

Local derivative features (landmark_00_local_dx, _dy, _dz, _cxx, _cyy) show 4-10 sign changes with 1-9 strong sign conflicts and relative node RMSE 0.41-0.78, indicating unstable, non-monotone contrast curves that do not support a single constant coordinate rule across the window.

hypotheses.direction: time-conditioned regional attention on landmark soft-mass contrast
hypotheses.falsifier: If the time-conditioned rule does not reduce relative node RMSE or sign conflicts versus the constant rule on held-out observed nodes, the hypothesis fails.
hypotheses.observable: landmark_00_soft_mass contrast at observed score nodes
hypotheses.statement: A time-conditioned regional attention recipe that follows the validated absolute contrast changes at observed score nodes may better express the non-monotone landmark soft-mass contrast than a static constant rule, because the soft-mass curve changes sign within the observed window.

limitations: No decoded terminal labels or current-study outcome data are supplied, so last-record or survival credit cannot be presented as final affinity benefit.
The continuous contrast functions are coordinate rewards, not trajectory velocity forces or absolute reward targets; no causal selection or neural-module causation is established.
Only the first six continuous_trends rows were read; the remaining 194 rows and the other evidence tables were not inspected in this turn.
